agent_assumptions: Interior corridor door heights assumed 2.1m absolute (2F floor base+2.1), not shown on any facade (interior partitions).

Window z heights combine North/West/East elevation evidence (sill1.0m/head2.8m above 2F floor) added to an assumed z_floor=3.0m for this draft-local placement; actual assembled z will be corrected by assemble_plan_bim floor-base translation using this draft's LOCAL z (see note: this draft was built with z_floor=0 so opening z here should be LOCAL not absolute -- see unresolved).
Ceiling height 3.6m and floor2 base 3.0m taken from North_view.png/West_view.png overall 6600mm total split 3000(1F)+3600(2F).
Partition walls modeled as centerlines without explicit thickness.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Opening z values were entered assuming absolute elevation from building base; must verify/correct against this draft's actual z_floor=0 local convention before or during assembly.
Exact interior corridor door height unmeasured from any facade.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

plan_compilation.basis: Calibrated from overall plan dimensions: horizontal 15000mm span pixel x=430 to x=1812; vertical 8000mm span pixel y=1082(bottom outer wall,world y=0) to y=342(top outer wall,world y=8). Outer footprint uses observed outer gray wall faces. Interior: one full-height spine wall at px x=1120 dividing two top meeting rooms; three spine walls at px x=733,1077,1427 dividing four bottom offices; both spine sets stop at a full-width corridor band py=604 to py=804 (open, no partition crossing it), matching the same layout pattern observed on 1f_view.png. Door apertures measured from swing-arc symbols flanking the spine walls at the corridor faces.

room_use_review.next_action: Read room_types and edits, inspect original room interiors, then use revise_bim/set_space_role to choose a plausible use, including a reasonable inference from building context. Prefer a broad listed type over unknown; avoid spending excessive effort distinguishing similar plausible uses. Read remaining cells with read_candidate_items; preserve physical partitions.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.
